ko.title: Rethinking the Internal Signal Path — Stage order · source domain · routing state 통합 검증판
ko.excerpt: ZUTA CORE, Fender MDX/Clapton, EMG SPC/RPC, Demeter MB-2, Wal, UNI-PRE, Peavey T-60의 stage-order/impedance-boundary 비교와 ESH/Eshtronic, magnetic/piezo source domain, EMG B125, McGrath programmable routing 검증을 하나의 B06으로 통합한다. Signal-flow graph, impedance-boundary map, control-state matrix, reference/bypass 및 power/failure state를 함께 기록하는 RavenForge internal-electronics specification framework를 확정한다.

en.title: Rethinking the Internal Signal Path — Unified stage-order, source-domain and routing-state verification
en.excerpt: Unifies the stage-order and impedance-boundary study of ZUTA CORE, Fender MDX/Clapton, EMG SPC/RPC, Demeter MB-2, Wal, UNI-PRE and the Peavey T-60 with verified ESH/Eshtronic, magnetic/piezo source-domain, EMG B125 and McGrath programmable-routing cases. B06 consolidates signal-flow graphs, impedance-boundary maps, control-state matrices, reference/bypass definitions and power/failure states into one RavenForge internal-electronics specification framework.

de.title: Rethinking the Internal Signal Path — Integrierte Verifikation von Stage Order, Quellendomänen und Routing-Zuständen
de.excerpt: Verbindet die Stage-Order-/Impedanzgrenzen-Analyse zu ZUTA CORE, Fender MDX/Clapton, EMG SPC/RPC, Demeter MB-2, Wal, UNI-PRE und Peavey T-60 mit verifizierten ESH/Eshtronic-, Magnet/Piezo-, EMG-B125- und McGrath-Routing-Fällen. B06 führt Signal-Flow Graph, Impedance Boundary Map, Control-State Matrix, Reference/Bypass sowie Power/Failure State zu einem RavenForge-Spezifikationsrahmen zusammen.
